drop: Drop files to attach them to your message
waitUploads: Wait until the files are uploaded and read.

modeHelp.document: The model reads the PDF itself, with its text and page images.
modeHelp.image: The model sees the image itself.
modeHelp.text: Nodestro extracts the text and tables locally; the model receives them as text.
modeHelp.ocr_text: A scanned PDF: Nodestro recognized its text locally (OCR). The text may contain errors.
modeHelp.overview: Too large to send in full: the model gets the structure and reads the parts it needs.
modeHelp.unavailable: The current model cannot read this file.

model.pdfOnly: {{model}} reads PDFs natively but cannot view images.
model.imagesOnly: {{model}} views images; PDFs are sent as extracted text.
model.none: {{model}} receives PDFs as extracted text and cannot view images.

list.label: Files in this chat
list.hint: Files stay in this chat until you delete them or the chat. In later messages the assistant can read them again; “Use again” sends a file in full with your next message. Nothing becomes knowledge unless you save it there.
list.reuseName: Use {{name}} again in the next message
list.reused: Already attached to the next message

preview.title: What Nodestro read from {{name}}
preview.empty: Nodestro read no text from this file (for example an image).
preview.truncated: Only the beginning is shown here.
